0.2.3.summary: Milim 0.2.3 brings pull request workflows, account runtime updates, editable Google Workspace files, sharper code review, and faster project actions.

items.title: Review and merge GitHub pull requests in Milim
items.description: Open a pull request from the Git inspector and keep the review beside your coding thread.
details: Track checks, approvals, and merge readiness
Read and reply to review comments
Merge without switching to GitHub

items.title: Update coding-agent CLIs from Milim
items.description: Manage Codex, Claude, OpenCode, and Pi from the Providers screen.
details: See installed and available versions
Run CLI updates without opening a terminal
Use the same approval modes across runtimes

items.title: Open and edit Google Workspace files
items.description: Keep selected Docs, Sheets, and Slides beside the conversation.
details: Edit Docs text and Sheets cells in place
Preview Slides without leaving Milim
Autosave supported changes back to Google

items.title: Act on projects from the sidebar
items.description: Project context menus now put common workspace and inbox actions within reach.
details: Open a project directly in File Explorer or Finder
Mark every unread thread in a project as read
Show the read action only when the project has unread threads

items.title: Review code without losing your place
items.description: Workspace review is easier to navigate, and macOS window handling follows expected shortcuts.
details: Browse workspace files from a hideable, resizable rail
Use the same syntax-highlighting theme for artifacts and workspace code
Hide Milim with Cmd+W when the URL browser does not consume the shortcut

0.2.2.summary: Milim 0.2.2 keeps Google Workspace edits fluid, clarifies tool approvals, and adds more control over the desktop layout.

items.title: Keep editing while previews refresh
items.description: Docs and Slides now preserve optimistic edits while saves, previews, and thumbnails reconcile in the background.
details: Edit contiguous Docs paragraphs in one native surface
Preserve mixed formatting while editing Slides text
Keep transformed elements visible across slide navigation

items.title: Review tool approvals with clearer context
items.description: Structured approval cards make runtime requests easier to inspect and act on.
details: Match Claude structured tool results reliably
Show approval details in a dedicated desktop prompt
Keep runtime behavior consistent across supported agents

items.title: Choose the collapsed sidebar rail
items.description: Appearance settings now offer regular, split, and compact centered collapsed sidebar layouts.
details: Keep the familiar full-height rail by default
Separate top and bottom actions into floating surfaces
Use the unified inspector shell across preview surfaces
Read nested projects and threads through quieter tree connectors

items.title: Stage app updates automatically
items.description: Available desktop updates can prepare in the background so installation is ready when you are.
details: Download update payloads without interrupting active work
Keep update progress visible in the desktop UI
Apply the staged update from the normal update flow
See sharper update cards with theme-colored provider marks

0.2.1.summary: Milim 0.2.1 fixes GitHub pull request avatars and conversation rendering in packaged desktop builds.

items.title: See complete pull request conversations
items.description: GitHub App identities and rich review content now render correctly in the PR cockpit.
details: Show GitHub App avatars when GitHub CLI omits the bot suffix
Render sanitized GitHub HTML in descriptions, reviews, and comments
Keep linked badges and attachment images inside conversation cards
